label: Rotation + raster shear + row jitter
challenge: The wordline/bitline array sits at a real stage angle, and the raster scan shears and jitters on top of that. Three independent geometric distortions stack -- no single linear correction undoes all of them at once.

label: Rotation + starved dose + detector noise
challenge: Near-maximum stage rotation on top of a starved electron dose and heavy detector noise. Fin/gate edges are both rotated and buried in grain.

label: Rotation + shear + CD bias grow
challenge: The fabricated storage-node contacts run wider than the design, the raster shears progressively top to bottom, and the frame is rotated on top of both.

label: Rotation + row jitter + vignette
challenge: Row-to-row scan jitter and strong edge vignetting wash out the gate/contact signal near the frame border, while the whole scene sits at an angle.

label: Rotation + starved dose + polygon-scale outliers
challenge: Local process variation scatters oversized/undersized contacts through the array, shot noise from a starved dose roughens every pixel, and it's rotated too.

label: Max rotation + shear + astigmatism
challenge: The full 10-degree rotation cap combined with raster shear and a strongly elliptical beam -- fin edges are directionally smeared, sheared, AND rotated.

label: Rotation + charging streaks + speckle
challenge: Bright charging streaks cut across the insulating separator rows, multiplicative speckle roughens the whole array, and it's rotated besides.

label: Rotation + shear + CD shrink
challenge: Fins and gates etch narrower than drawn, the raster shears progressively top to bottom, and the frame carries a real stage rotation on top.

label: Rotation + detector noise + gamma expand
challenge: A blown-out, overexposed capture with heavy sensor noise, rotated near the 10-degree cap -- low contrast and geometric misalignment together.

label: Rotation + starved dose + CD bias grow
challenge: Fins and contacts print systematically oversized, the capture is shot-noise starved, and a real stage tilt sits on top of both.

label: Rotation + row jitter + salt-pepper
challenge: Row-to-row scan jitter and sparse impulse-noise pixels corrupt the array independently of a near-maximum whole-frame rotation.

label: Max rotation + vignette + speckle
challenge: Full rotation cap, edge vignetting, and brightness-scaled speckle together -- the true match may sit in the dimmest, noisiest part of the frame.

label: Rotation + shear + detector noise
challenge: A sheared raster scan and constant-variance sensor noise both distort the bitline pattern, with a near-maximum stage rotation layered on top.

label: Rotation + row jitter + charging streaks
challenge: Row-to-row jitter and bright charging streaks over the spacer regions both corrupt the fin/gate pattern, on top of a real stage tilt.

label: Rotation + starved dose + astigmatism
challenge: Low-dose shot noise and directional astigmatic blur degrade the signal along with a near-maximum rotation -- three compounding acquisition problems.

label: Rotation + shear + CD grow
challenge: Systematically oversized fins/contacts on top of a sheared raster scan, captured at a near-maximum stage angle.

label: Rotation + row jitter + gamma crush
challenge: A dark, contrast-crushed capture with unstable row-to-row jitter, plus a real whole-frame rotation on top.

label: Max rotation + shear + detector noise
challenge: The hardest geometric combination: full rotation cap, strong raster shear, and heavy sensor noise all applied to the same frame at once.

label: Rotation + starved dose + salt-pepper
challenge: Sparse impulse-noise pixels and shot-noise grain from a starved dose combine with a real stage rotation -- individually survivable, compounding together.

label: Max rotation + shear + astigmatism
challenge: Directional beam blur and progressive raster shear both smear fin/gate edges, and the whole capture carries the full 10-degree stage rotation.
